description: This file defines the ModuleBuilderViewWizard class, which manages the display and processing of different views within the Module Builder and Studio interfaces of SuiteCRM. It handles generating buttons, breadcrumbs, and view-specific content for module customization.

classes.name: ModuleBuilderViewWizard
classes.description: A class that manages the display and processing of different views in the SuiteCRM Module Builder and Studio interfaces, including generating buttons, breadcrumbs, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view and editModule properties based on request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the view by processing either ModuleBuilder or Studio content and outputting the assembled interface.

methods.name: processStudio
methods.description: Handles the logic for Studio views, generating buttons and breadcrumbs based on the selected view type.

methods.name: processMB
methods.description: Handles ModuleBuilder views, generating buttons and breadcrumbs for different module editing contexts.

methods.name: generateStudioModuleButtons
methods.description: Loads available Studio modules and creates buttons for each.

methods.name: generateMBViewButtons
methods.description: Creates buttons for editing different layouts and views of a module.

methods.name: generateMBDashletButtons
methods.description: Creates buttons related to dashlet views within ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: generateMBPopupButtons
methods.description: Creates buttons for popup views in ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: generateMBSearchButtons
methods.description: Creates search layout buttons for ModuleBuilder.
